questions.question: Three of the following four words are alike in a certain way and one is different. Pick out the odd word.
questions.questionHtml: Three of the following four words are alike in a certain way and one is different. Pick out the odd word.
questions.solution:
All options except “Victoria Memorial” are monuments present in New Delhi, while “Victoria Memorial” is present in West Bengal.

Hence, “Victoria Memorial” is the correct answer.

questions.question: In the following question, select the odd word pair from the given alternatives.
questions.questionHtml: In the following question, select the odd word pair from the given alternatives.
questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is:-

1) Number of sides in a 'Square' → Four

2) Number of sides in a 'Hexagon' → Six

3) Number of sides in a 'Cone' → Instead of the number of sides, the word 'Figure' is given (this means that Cone - figure is an odd word pair)

4) Number of sides in a 'Triangle' → Three

Hence, the correct answer is "Cone - Figure".

questions.question: Four word-pairs have been given, out of which three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the one that is different.
questions.questionHtml: Four word-pairs have been given, out of which three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the one that is different.
questions.solution:
Logic: We have to eliminate the odd pair of the following:

Option 1: Author ∶ Pen

Pen is used by the Author for writing a book.

Option 2: Chef ∶ Knife 

A Knife is used by Chef for cutting vegetables.

Option 3: Doctor ∶ Patient

The Doctor treats the Patient.

Option 4: Tailor ∶ Needle

The needle is used by Tailor for stitching the clothes.

As it can be seen that all options are analogous except "Option 3".

Hence, the correct answer should be "Option 3 : Doctor ∶ Patient".

questions.question: Four words are given, three of which are alike in a certain way while one is not. Select the inconsistent word.
questions.questionHtml: Four words are given, three of which are alike in a certain way while one is not. Select the inconsistent word.
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Option (1) Gastroenterologist → A gastroenterology is a specialist doctor of diseases of the stomach and liver and the diseases that affect the digestive system.

Option (2) Psychiatrist → A psychiatrist is a general medical doctor who diagnoses and treats mental, emotional, and behavioural disorders.

Option (3) Cardiologist → A cardiologist is a specialist doctor of diseases of the heart.

Option (4) Ophthalmologist → An ophthalmologist is a specialist doctor of diseases of the eye and vision care.

Hence, “Psychiatrist” is an odd one.

questions.question: In the following question, select the odd word pair from the given alternatives.
questions.questionHtml: In the following question, select the odd word pair from the given alternatives.
questions.solution:
The logic here is as follows:

Cricket – Pitch → Cricket is played on a Pitch

Hockey – Ground → Hockey is played on the Ground

Wrestling – Arena → Wrestling is played in the Arena

Skating - Ring → Skating is not played in the Ring (It is played in Rink)

Hence, the correct answer is "Skating - Ring".

questions.question: Identify the odd pair from the following
questions.questionHtml: Identify the odd pair from the following
questions.solution:
The pattern followed is,

Option 1 → Cairo is the capital of Egypt.

Option 2 → Dinar is the currency of Iraq.

Option 3 → Athens is the capital of Greece.

Option 4 → Rome is the capital of Italy.

All follow the same pattern, except ‘Iraq: Dinar’.

Hence, “Iraq: Dinar” is the odd pair.
